source_summary: Vertical blue-green Chinese landscape with towering layered mountains, misty distant peaks, pine-covered rocky terraces, and foreground pavilion architecture set among bridges, trees, and large textured boulders; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: high_twin_peak_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the upper central double mountain massif: two tall rounded peaks rising behind a saddle, with blue-green and ochre washes, layered contour strokes, dark ink texture marks, and the small pine silhouettes on the lower right shoulder of the ridge.
must_preserve: rounded twin-peak silhouette
overlapping blue-green and ochre washes
dense dark cun texture strokes near the crest and right face
soft misted lower edges where the forms fade
tiny pine silhouettes on the lower ridge

motifs.name: left_blue_cliff_column
motifs.description: Isolate the large left midground cliff column, including its vertical rounded wall, blue mineral highlights, ochre rock planes, black broken texture strokes, and the stepped rocky ledges at its lower right edge.
must_preserve: vertical cliff silhouette fading into mist at the base
blue-green washes along ridges and ledges
short dark ink hatch marks and contour lines
ochre angular rock facets
stepped lower ledges without nearby pavilion architecture

motifs.name: central_cascading_rock_gully
motifs.description: Isolate the central descending rocky gully and ridge system beneath the high peaks, with interlocking blue and ochre cliff faces, a pale winding ravine, clustered ridge pines, and dark texture strokes following the slope.
must_preserve: diagonal cascading composition of cliffs and ravine
blue-green mineral wash on exposed rock shelves
ochre-orange cliff accents
ink contour lines and dry-brush texture marks
small upright pines grouped along the ridge crests

motifs.name: right_misty_distant_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the mist-filled right background with a small rounded island-like peak, a taller pale vertical peak behind it, and the partial orange-blue cliff at the far right edge, all softened by open atmospheric wash.
must_preserve: soft mist gaps around isolated peaks
faint vertical distant peak silhouette
small dark-textured rounded peak in the middle distance
partial far-right cliff with blue-green wash and ochre edges
subtle fading edges rather than hard outlines

motifs.name: center_left_pine_grove_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the center-left pine grove on the sloping terrace: tall slender trunks, flat-topped needle clusters, nearby shrubs, and the pale rocky ground that supports them.
must_preserve: thin vertical pine trunks
fine dotted and clustered needle brushwork
varied tree heights and leaning trunks
pale slope contours beneath the trees
small dark shrub masses between the pines

motifs.name: cliffside_pavilion_with_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the central cliffside pavilion group, including the main building on stilts, adjoining roofed structure, balcony railings, visible small scholar figure, and surrounding low rocks that anchor the architecture.
must_preserve: precise tiled roof geometry and ridge lines
wooden posts and stilt supports
balcony railing pattern
small human figure inside the upper pavilion
light red-brown architectural accents and nearby anchoring rocks

motifs.name: lower_left_lakeside_pavilions_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left lakeside architecture and crossing: the arched bridge in the misty background, the round-roof pavilion, the lower rectangular building with slanted roof, surrounding rocks, and small trees at the water or open-ground edge.
must_preserve: sequence of pale bridge arches
curved pavilion roof with dark ridge and eaves
straight roof lines of the lower building
blue-green rocks framing the structures
fine tree foliage and trunks around the architecture

motifs.name: foreground_right_rock_garden
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground right rock garden: large layered blue-green boulders, dark crag hollow, rounded ochre ridges, dense shrubs and small trees, plus the narrow orange cliff/path fragments along the right side.
must_preserve: large stacked boulder contours
blue-green mineral highlights on rock crowns
dark ink crag hollow and heavy texture marks
dense dotted shrub foliage and fine branching
ochre cliff facets and narrow path-like edges

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
